name: fxr_truce_pay_prompt
doc: Stands in for saves/ferry_re/truce_pay_prompt.state, as disasm/notes/ow_ferry.md sec. 7 made it: the clerk (obj8, out of the ROM's action box from every cell beside the counter) poked beside Crono ($1810 = 0680), Left 2 frames and A: 'It's 10 G to Porre. Hop aboard?', waiting with the cursor on Yes ($0129 = 07, $0162 = 02), 60 frames after the A.
